bio: Vernon Miller is a REALTOR® serving Orange County, Los Angeles County, and Riverside County, with a primary focus on Orange County. A Cypress local of more than 30 years, he brings a special focus to the community. Licensed since 2014 and fluent in Japanese, Vernon specializes in first-time home buyers, residential selling, investment opportunities, and commercial real estate. He is affiliated with The Real Estate Solution and the Kathy Zajac Real Estate Team.
